paraphrase: 'Being-time' (uji) means that time itself is already being and all being is time; each moment and each thing abides in its own dharma-position; being-time passes (kyōryaku) from today to tomorrow and from today to yesterday; the self set out in array is the whole world.
speaker: Dōgen
notes: From memory; the text is not held locally, so no original is quoted and section labels are descriptive.
